statement.title: Accessibility
statement.intro: Takeoff Engine values accessibility for people with disabilities and welcomes feedback on its website and construction estimating tools.
statement.status: The Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, Level AA, serve as our accessibility goal and guide our design and development efforts.
statement.ongoing: Accessibility is a continuous effort, not a one-time project. We regularly review, test, and update our website and tools to improve accessibility and address barriers. New features are developed with accessibility in mind, and we welcome your feedback to help us prioritize improvements.
statement.limitations: This statement describes our accessibility goal and contact process. It is not a certification, guarantee, or representation of full conformance to any standard. Some pages or features may not yet fully conform to WCAG 2.2 Level AA.
statement.scope: This statement applies to the Takeoff Engine website and web application at takeoffengine.com. Certain content or features may not yet fully meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA, including: legacy content published before this statement; user-uploaded documents, plans, and files; third-party widgets, integrations, and embedded content; and PDF or other downloadable documents. We are actively working to reduce these gaps over time.
statement.thirdParty: Our website and tools may include or link to third-party content, services, and integrations, such as payment processing. We do not control the accessibility of third-party content and are not responsible for its conformance with any accessibility standard. If you encounter an accessibility barrier on a third-party service accessed through our site, please contact that third party directly.
statement.compatibility: We aim to support recent versions of major browsers and commonly used assistive technologies, including screen readers. However, we cannot guarantee full compatibility with every browser, operating system, device, or assistive technology configuration. If you experience a compatibility issue, please contact us with details about your setup so we can investigate.
statement.noticeTitle: Good-Faith Notice and Opportunity to Respond
statement.notice: If you experience an accessibility barrier, please contact us before pursuing any formal claim so we can investigate and work with you toward an effective solution. Where permitted by applicable law, you agree to provide written notice by email describing the specific barrier, including the page URL, the task you were trying to complete, the assistive technology you were using, and a description of the difficulty you experienced. You further agree to allow us 60 days from receipt of your notice to acknowledge, investigate, and implement or discuss a reasonable solution before filing a lawsuit or other formal proceeding. We encourage informal resolution, including mediation, as a preferred path. This request does not apply to emergencies and does not waive or limit any rights or remedies that cannot lawfully be limited.
statement.noWarranty: THE WEBSITE AND SERVICES ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTIES OF ANY KIND, EITHER EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO WARRANTIES OF ACCESSIBILITY, MERCHANTABILITY, NON-INFRINGEMENT, OR FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE, TO THE FULLEST EXTENT PERMITTED BY APPLICABLE LAW.
statement.liability: TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY APPLICABLE LAW, TAKEOFF ENGINE AND ITS OWNERS, AFFILIATES, OFFICERS, EMPLOYEES, AND CONTRIBUTORS SHALL NOT BE LIABLE FOR ANY DIRECT, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, PUNITIVE, OR EXEMPLARY DAMAGES ARISING OUT OF OR RELATED TO ACCESSIBILITY BARRIERS ON THE WEBSITE, THE USE OR INABILITY TO USE THE WEBSITE OR ITS SERVICES, OR THIS ACCESSIBILITY STATEMENT, EVEN IF ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGES.
statement.contact: Contact us with accessibility questions, feedback, or requests for assistance or an alternative format.
statement.details: To help us understand and respond to your request, please include the page URL, the task involved, a description of the barrier or your experience, and the assistive technology you were using, if relevant. Do not send passwords, payment information, or confidential project data.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.subtitle: How Takeoff Engine protects, handles, and processes your data
privacyPolicy.s1Body: We collect information you provide directly when creating an account, uploading takeoff spreadsheets, generating estimates, and configuring your contractor profile (such as name, email address, company branding, and project takeoff data). We also automatically collect certain information when you use the Service, including log data (IP address, browser type, operating system, referring URLs), device information, usage analytics (pages viewed, features used, session duration), and cookies or similar tracking technologies as described in our Cookies section. When making a purchase, payment details are securely collected and processed by our Merchant of Record, Paddle. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 16.
privacyPolicy.s2Body: We use the information we collect to: provide, maintain, secure, and improve Takeoff Engine; calculate estimates and generate export documents; process transactions and manage subscriptions; send service notices, security alerts, and administrative communications; provide customer support; detect, investigate, and prevent fraud, abuse, and security incidents; perform analytics and research to understand usage patterns and improve features; comply with legal obligations and enforce our Terms of Service; and protect the rights, property, and safety of Takeoff Engine, its users, and the public.
privacyPolicy.s3Body: Takeoff Engine uses cookies, local storage, and similar tracking technologies to authenticate users, maintain sessions, remember preferences, analyze usage, and improve the Service. Essential cookies are required for the Service to function and cannot be disabled. Analytics and performance cookies help us understand how the Service is used. You may control or disable non-essential cookies through your browser settings; however, disabling cookies may limit your ability to use certain features of the Service. We do not use tracking technologies for cross-site advertising without your consent.
privacyPolicy.s4Body: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information or proprietary project data to third parties. We may share your information only in the following circumstances: with service providers and subprocessors who assist in operating the Service (such as hosting, payment processing, analytics, and email delivery), under contractual obligations to protect your data; with Paddle.com as Merchant of Record for payment processing; when required by law, court order, or governmental authority; to protect the rights, property, or safety of Takeoff Engine, its users, or the public; in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, in which case we will notify you of any change in ownership or use of your data; and with your explicit consent.
privacyPolicy.s5Body: You retain full ownership of all takeoff spreadsheets, project bids, rate libraries, and customer data uploaded to Takeoff Engine. We do not sell, rent, or trade your proprietary takeoff data or client proposals to third parties. You may export or delete your project data at any time through your account settings. When you delete data, it is removed from active systems; however, residual copies may remain in encrypted backups for a limited period as required for disaster recovery, legal compliance, or dispute resolution, after which they are permanently destroyed.
privacyPolicy.s6Body: All subscription payments, invoicing, and tax calculations are securely managed by Paddle.com (Paddle Payments Ltd / Paddle.com Market Ltd), acting as Merchant of Record. Takeoff Engine does not store raw credit card numbers, CVV codes, or full bank account details on its servers. Paddle processes payment data under its own privacy policy and is responsible for the handling of your payment information.
privacyPolicy.s7Body: We implement commercially reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect your data, including encryption in transit and at rest, access controls, and regular security assessments. However, no method of transmission or electronic storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security. We retain your personal information and project data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide the Service, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. In the event of a data breach that is likely to result in a risk to your rights and freedoms, we will notify you and relevant authorities as required by applicable law without undue delay.
privacyPolicy.s8Body: Takeoff Engine is operated from the United States. If you access the Service from outside the United States, your information may be transferred to, stored, and processed in the United States or other jurisdictions where our service providers operate. By using the Service, you consent to the transfer of your data to jurisdictions that may have different data protection laws than your country of residence. We take appropriate safeguards to protect your data during international transfers in accordance with applicable law.
privacyPolicy.s9Body: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to: access the personal information we hold about you; request correction of inaccurate data; request deletion of your personal data, subject to legal retention obligations; request a copy of your data in a portable format; object to or restrict certain processing of your data; and withdraw consent where processing is based on consent. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at the address below. We will respond to verified requests within the timeframes required by applicable law. We may decline requests that are frivolous, excessive, or would adversely affect the rights of others.
privacyPolicy.s10Body: Takeoff Engine is not directed to children under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we become aware that we have collected personal information from a child under 16 without parental consent, we will take steps to delete that information. If you believe we have collected information from a child, please contact us immediately.
privacyPolicy.s11Body: California residents have additional rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA), including the right to know what personal information is collected, the right to delete personal information, the right to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information, and the right to non-discrimination for exercising these rights. Takeoff Engine does not sell personal information as defined by the CCPA. To exercise your California privacy rights, contact us at the address below. We will verify your identity before processing your request.
privacyPolicy.s12Body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, technology, legal requirements, or other factors. We will notify you of material changes by posting the updated policy on the Service with a revised effective date and, where required, by sending you an email notification. Your continued use of the Service after the effective date of the updated policy constitutes your acceptance of the changes.
privacyPolicy.s13Body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, wish to exercise your data privacy rights, or want to contact our data protection representative, please email us at pattygsocials@gmail.com. If you are located in the European Economic Area or United Kingdom, you also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection supervisory authority.

refundPolicy.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
refundPolicy.subtitle: Clear, straightforward guidelines on cancellations, refunds, and renewals
refundPolicy.s1Body: You may cancel your Takeoff Engine subscription at any time directly through your Account Settings or via the Paddle Customer Portal. When you cancel, your subscription will remain active until the end of your current paid billing period, and you will not be charged again. Cancellation does not entitle you to a pro-rata refund for the unused portion of your current billing period. Upon cancellation, you may export your project data through your account settings before your access expires. We do not guarantee data availability after your subscription period ends. We reserve the right to modify, discontinue, or change subscription plans at any time with reasonable notice.
refundPolicy.s2Body: We offer a 14-day refund guarantee for first-time subscribers on their initial subscription purchase. To be eligible, you must submit your refund request within 14 calendar days of your initial purchase date by contacting us at pattygsocials@gmail.com or via Paddle Support. Refund requests submitted after the 14-day window will not be honored. This guarantee applies only to your first subscription purchase and does not apply to renewals, upgrades, downgrades, plan changes, or subsequent purchases. Takeoff Engine reserves the right to deny refund requests if we determine that the Service was used extensively during the refund period or if the request appears to be an abuse of this policy. Refunds will be processed to the original payment method within 5 to 10 business days of approval. Annual plan refunds are subject to the same 14-day window from the initial purchase date.
refundPolicy.s3Body: Subscriptions automatically renew at the end of each billing cycle (monthly or annual) unless cancelled prior to the renewal date. Reminder notifications and paid invoice receipts are emailed to your registered billing email. Renewal charges are non-refundable except as required by applicable law or as expressly stated in this policy. If your payment method is declined or expires, we may attempt to collect payment using any other valid payment method on file, and your subscription may be suspended until payment is received.
refundPolicy.s4Body: When you upgrade your subscription plan, the price difference will be prorated for the remainder of your current billing period, and you will be charged immediately. When you downgrade, the change takes effect at the start of your next billing cycle; no partial refund or credit is issued for the current period. Upgrades and downgrades do not restart the 14-day refund guarantee. Feature access and seat limits will be adjusted immediately upon plan changes.
refundPolicy.s5Body: The following are non-refundable under all circumstances: one-time purchases or add-ons (unless otherwise stated at the time of purchase); fees paid for usage beyond your plan limits; any charges incurred after the 14-day refund window has expired; and any amounts that have already been refunded or credited. Tax amounts included in your payment may be refunded only to the extent required by applicable law.
refundPolicy.s6Body: All subscription payments, invoicing, refund processing, chargebacks, and tax collections are handled by Paddle.com (Paddle Payments Ltd / Paddle.com Market Ltd) as our Merchant of Record in compliance with consumer protection standards and PCI-DSS requirements. Takeoff Engine does not directly process payments or refunds. All refund requests are subject to Paddle's processing timelines and policies. In the event of a chargeback or payment dispute initiated with your bank or payment provider, Takeoff Engine reserves the right to contest the chargeback and to provide evidence of service delivery. Accounts with chargebacks may be suspended pending resolution.
refundPolicy.s7Body: If you experience any billing discrepancies, have questions regarding an invoice, or wish to dispute a charge, please email pattygsocials@gmail.com or contact Paddle support directly. We aim to acknowledge billing inquiries within 2 business days. Please include your account email, the invoice number or transaction ID, and a description of the issue. For disputed charges, please contact us before initiating a chargeback with your bank to allow us the opportunity to resolve the matter directly.
refundPolicy.s8Body: Takeoff Engine reserves the right to modify this Refund & Cancellation Policy at any time by posting the updated version on the Service and updating the effective date. Material changes will be communicated through the Service or by email. Your continued use of the Service after the effective date of any changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy. Changes to this policy do not affect refund eligibility for purchases made before the effective date of the change.

legalDisclaimer.s1Body: Takeoff Engine provides computational tools and automated quantity processing designed to assist construction contractors, estimators, and engineers. All calculations, pricing summaries, trench earthwork models, rate applications, and export documents generated by this software are estimates only and are provided for informational and planning purposes. Takeoff Engine does NOT provide architectural, structural, civil engineering, surveying, legal, accounting, or licensed professional consulting services. We do NOT guarantee the mathematical completeness, pricing sufficiency, profitability, or bidding success of any estimate produced. The output of this software should never be used as the sole basis for any construction bid, contract, or financial decision without independent professional verification.
legalDisclaimer.s2Body: The user (contractor, subcontractor, estimator, or any other person or entity using the Service) maintains sole and exclusive responsibility for verifying all project dimensions, quantities, specifications, and costs prior to submitting any bid, executing any contract, or ordering construction materials. Specifically, users acknowledge and agree that:
legalDisclaimer.s2Item1: Plan & Specification Review: The user is solely responsible for cross-referencing all takeoff quantities against complete engineering plan sets, geotechnical soil reports, addenda, and project specifications. Takeoff Engine does not review, validate, or verify the accuracy of uploaded plans or drawings.
legalDisclaimer.s2Item2: Subsurface & Geotechnical Conditions: Soil excavation volumes, trench depths, swell/shrinkage factors, and rock/water classifications must be verified by field borings and local conditions. Takeoff Engine's trench calculations are geometric estimations and do not account for subsurface rock, unlocatable utilities, adverse trenching collapse, groundwater, or other site-specific conditions.
legalDisclaimer.s2Item3: Material & Labor Price Volatility: Material costs, supplier quotes, fuel surcharges, labor wage escalations, prevailing wage requirements, and regional market volatility must be independently confirmed with local suppliers, trade unions, and labor authorities before bid submission. Takeoff Engine does not provide real-time pricing data and is not responsible for price fluctuations.
legalDisclaimer.s2Item4: Scope Completeness & Exclusions: Missing scope badges, unmapped items, and placeholder tokens (TBD, HOLD, N/A) must be reviewed manually. The software does not verify whether all bid requirements or drawing details are fully captured. Users must independently verify that all project scope, exclusions, allowances, and contingencies are properly accounted for.

Discrimination, harassment, or abusive conduct will not be tolerated. Takeoff Engine reserves the right, in its sole discretion, to determine whether any communication or conduct violates these standards.
